scope: Read-only task recommendation and interval audit of all 734 local seed records; no production or seed mutations.
methodology: Every record has been enumerated and validated structurally; source availability is distinct from botanical verification of all fields.
Species matching uses heading equality and explicit synonyms. Generic genus guidance is labeled separately.
Flag names mean optional generated reminder suggestions. moisture_required maps to misting, not merely checking moisture.
Primary-source numerical regimens differ with dose, growing season, medium, light and climate; interval differences are candidates unless a clear conflict or unsafe missing condition is established.

Never infer an enabled pruning flag for seasonal/after-flowering pruning from a generic days interval. Existing 14 positive pruning cadences remain editorial suggestions, not source-prescribed numbers.
The mobile 12-month repot slider clamp is covered in the parent integration audit, not duplicated here.

findings.title: Regular generic fertilizer enabled for a nutrient-sensitive pitcher plant
findings.recommended_action: Disable the generic recurring fertilising suggestion (false/null). Specialist experimental feeding is a separate care method, not the present unspecific task.

findings.title: Automatic foliar misting conflicts with African-violet leaf care
findings.recommended_action: Set the misting recommendation false/null. Keep humidity management separate from spraying leaves.

findings.title: Generic repeated leaf misting is not the same as conditional dormant-tuber care
findings.recommended_action: Disable generic foliar misting. A source mentioning occasional tuber moistening during storage does not justify an all-year foliage-spraying task.

findings.title: Misting promotes crown/leaf wetting that species guidance avoids
findings.recommended_action: Disable generic foliar misting. Use ambient humidity without routine wetting of foliage or the crown.

findings.title: An unconditional 14-day watering task omits essential dry phases
findings.recommended_action: Do not prescribe watering every 14 days throughout the year. Pending phase-aware reminders, disable the automatic watering recommendation or explicitly treat it as an inspection reminder, with watering conditional on growth/leaf-replacement stage and dry medium; do not merely substitute another fixed number.

findings.title: Monthly feeding is much more frequent than the reviewed species source
findings.recommended_action: Review toward once or twice yearly for an ordinary liquid-feed regime; 180–365 days is an editorial starting range derived from that regimen, not a universal interval for every formulation. Record dosage and season before changing production.

findings.title: 60-day feeding differs from guidance for the accepted synonym
findings.recommended_action: Review the 60-day default against the source’s twice-yearly regime for Ficus maclellandii; do not change frequency without choosing fertilizer formulation/dose.

findings.title: Monthly feeding exceeds a light, infrequent growing-season regime
findings.recommended_action: Replace the universal monthly recommendation with a light growing-season regime only after specifying fertilizer strength; source suggests one or two applications in that period.

findings.title: Container-fern fertilizer suggestion is disabled despite species guidance
findings.recommended_action: Offer optional feeding for container-grown plants. The reviewed species source supports the flag but provides no numeric cadence, so do not invent a source-backed interval; choose and label a conservative editorial regimen separately.

findings.title: Unspecific monthly fertilizer task cannot express specialized pitcher-plant feeding
findings.recommended_action: Hold a generic root-fertilizer suggestion until strength, application method, active growth and insect availability are represented. Do NOT mark Nepenthes as never fertilizable: dilute specialized feeding can be appropriate.

findings.title: Butterwort feeding/watering varies with rosette phase and method

findings.title: A 12?24-month repot schedule requires annual versus perennial cultivation context
findings.recommended_action: For a specimen grown as a one-season annual crop/display, disable recurring 1?2-year repotting; seedling potting-on is a different operation. Retain or adjust repotting only after confirming whether the actual specimen is perennial/overwintered in its climate. A source describing annual cultivation does not prove the species is an obligate annual everywhere.
findings.details: Species-source life-cycle/cultivation evidence is distinct from the proposed task setting. Tropaeolum majus and other tender taxa may persist as perennials in frost-free conditions; the existing schema does not capture that context.
